full_prompt_en: This square oil painting is a close bust portrait of a young dark-haired sitter against a deep brown ground. The head is placed near the center, with the shoulders descending into the lower corners. Thick, dark, slightly tousled curls frame the forehead and ears and almost merge with the unlit background. The sitter faces outward but turns a little toward the right side of the picture; dark eyes meet the viewer with a calm, unsmiling expression. The face is modeled through small warm shifts of ochre, rose, and umber rather than outlined sharply. Light arrives from the upper left and catches the forehead, nose ridge, cheeks, and upper lip. It leaves the hair and the side of the jaw much darker, while soft reflected warmth keeps the shadowed features visible. The mouth is closed and gently colored red. Below the chin, an open, loosely folded white cloth collar makes the brightest shape in the lower half of the image. Its ridges are suggested by pale cream strokes and narrow gray-brown creases. A deep green outer garment surrounds this white area and is rendered more broadly than the face, with the shoulder at the right edge slipping into shadow. The background offers no setting or objects; its uneven warm darkness allows the lit planes of the head to emerge without a hard cutout. Visible brushwork follows the hair and cloth while the face remains comparatively smooth. The painting holds a restrained, direct presence through concentrated warm light, dark surrounding color, and a simple head-and-shoulders arrangement.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形油画半身近景，深棕背景前坐着一位深发年轻人物。头部靠近中央，肩部向下伸入两侧下角。厚密、微乱的深色卷发围绕前额与耳朵，几乎融进无光的背景。人物面向外侧，又稍稍转向画面右方；深色双眼平静地迎向观看者，神情不带笑意。面部通过赭黄、玫瑰色与棕褐色的细微暖调变化塑造，而非用锐利轮廓圈住。光从左上方照来，落在前额、鼻梁、双颊和上唇，让头发与下颌侧面深得多；柔和的反射暖光仍使背光五官可见。嘴唇闭合，带轻微红色。下巴之下，敞开且松散折叠的白布领成为画面下半部最亮的形状。浅奶油色笔触和细窄灰棕褶痕暗示其起伏。深绿外衣环绕白领，比面部画得更概括，右边缘的肩部没入阴影。背景没有环境或物件；不均匀的暖暗色使受光的头部自然浮现，却不显生硬剪贴。可见笔触顺着头发和布料走向，面部则相对平滑。集中暖光、周围深色与简洁的头肩安排共同形成克制而直接的在场感。
style_prompt_en: Oil painting builds volume with layered warm earth colors against a dark, uneven ground. A focused light area emerges gradually from surrounding brown and green-black passages, and reflected warmth keeps the shadow from becoming empty. Edges vary from softly blended transitions to a few crisp light-dark accents. Small controlled strokes smooth prominent planes, while looser directional marks describe textured and folded areas. Cream highlights form a concentrated counterweight to broad low-value masses. The composition is compact and restrained, with painterly surface variation supporting an intimate, quietly dramatic sense of depth.
style_prompt_zh: 油画以层叠的暖土色在深而不匀的底色上建立体积。集中的亮区从周围棕色与绿黑色笔触中渐渐浮现，反射暖光使阴影不至于空洞。边缘在柔和融合的过渡与少数清脆明暗重音之间变化。细小而受控的笔触抚平突出平面，较松的定向痕迹则描述有纹理和褶皱的区域。奶油色高光与大面积低明度形体形成集中对位。构图紧凑克制，富变化的绘画表面支撑亲近、安静而略带戏剧性的纵深。
theme_en: A young dark-haired sitter in a white collar against a deep brown ground
theme_zh: 深棕背景前身着白领的深发年轻人物
name: Charles Gleyre
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
